messages.content: Capacity plan: 6 web nodes, each 8 vCPU and 32GB RAM. 3 database nodes, each 16 vCPU and 64GB RAM. 4 cache nodes, each 8GB RAM. Peak throughput target 18,000 RPS. P99 latency target < 220ms. DB connection pool max 180 per app node. Monthly cost cap $9,600. Rollout starts 2026-07-09.
Spec captured: web/db/cache sizing, 18k RPS, P99 <220ms, pool 180, cost cap $9,600, rollout July 9.
